entries.description: Daily mutation #163: Color scheme → starry-night (deep contemplative blue), new hero tagline, all 5 headings rewritten, all fact/quote indices rotated dramatically, Today section rewritten, new aurora SVG visual asset
changes: Color scheme rotated: sunflower (warm gold) → starry-night (contemplative deep blue #1a237e + gold #ffd54f accents + cyan #4fc3f7), reordered array so dayOfYear%5=1 selects starry-night
Hero tagline: 'Every darkness is a canvas waiting for its stars' (was 'Where gold light learns to breathe')
Rewrote all 5 section headings with fresh poetic language and <em> emphasis

Moon: 'What the night keeps in trust' | Philosophy: 'Dissolving the outline of the self' | Gita: 'The surrender that is harder than war' | Shiva: 'The sound that precedes creation' | Art: 'The alchemy of seeing truly'
Rotated imageCard factIndex: Moon=2 (Selene/Endymion), Philosophy=11 (ego castle on sand), Gita=5 (Gita spoken on battlefield), Shiva=4 (Shiva's drum/language), Art=14 (brushstroke as decision)
Rotated facts.slice: Moon=[7,9], Philosophy=[1,3], Gita=[10,12], Shiva=[11,13], Art=[6,8]

Rotated quoteIndex: Moon=1 (Gibran: darker side), Philosophy=7 (Atrijā: ego walls/soul bridges), Gita=0 (Gita: believe in), Shiva=2 (Inspired: Supreme Lord in all beings), Art=3 (Degas: make others see)
Rewrote Today heading: 'The listening sky — where light bends into color'
Rewrote Today intro: aurora as conversation, geometry of wonder, solar wind and magnetic field ceremony
Generated new SVG visual asset: visual.svg — aurora borealis with vivid green, purple, pink, gold, teal on starlit sky
